title: Gathering Materials
summary: The twelve crafting materials used at the Crafting Altar to make cosmetics - nine gathered anywhere in the Hub, three found only in Diamond Trophy. All twelve stack without limit and are held account-wide across every server.

entries.name: Base Material
entries.description: The common thread in every recipe.
entries.how_to_get: By far the most common material: the largest pool in every pocket bag and crate loot table (Small Pocket Bag, Large Pocket Bag, Common Crate, Rare Crate), an occasional Daily Chest item-slot roll, and a small direct trickle (capped per day) from hub PvP arena kills, hub parkour runs, opening the Daily Chest itself, and Diamond Trophy mob kills and act clears. Not a Quest Board reward directly - quests pay pocket bags, crates and keys, which then contain materials.
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar. It appears in nearly every cosmetic recipe, usually in the largest quantity, and is also one of the two ingredients (with Forged Steel) in the Common Key recipe.
entries.icon_hint: a small rough grey-brown lump, like a plain ball of unfired clay, no shine or detail
entries.notes: Stacks without limit. The most common material by far, and the base ingredient of almost every recipe. Real texture: rc_materials/resourcepack/rc_materials/textures/item/base_material.png

entries.name: Leather
entries.how_to_get: A materials-pool roll in Small/Large Pocket Bags and Common Crates, plus a small direct trickle from hub PvP arena kills, hub parkour runs, opening the Daily Chest, and Diamond Trophy mob kills and act clears. Not a direct Quest Board reward.
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar for recipes with a medieval or fabric-based look.
entries.icon_hint: a small folded square of tanned brown leather with visible stitched edges

entries.name: Warm Powder
entries.description: Dyes cosmetics in reds, oranges and yellows.
entries.how_to_get: A materials-pool roll in Small/Large Pocket Bags and Common Crates, plus a small direct trickle from hub PvP arena kills, hub parkour runs, opening the Daily Chest, and Diamond Trophy act clears. Not a direct Quest Board reward.
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar for warm-colored recipes.
entries.icon_hint: a small heap of fine glowing powder in red-orange-yellow gradient, like warm embers ground fine

entries.name: Cold Powder
entries.description: Dyes cosmetics in blues, cyans and purples.
entries.how_to_get: A materials-pool roll in Small/Large Pocket Bags and Common Crates, plus a small direct trickle from hub PvP arena kills, hub parkour runs, opening the Daily Chest, and Diamond Trophy act clears. Not a direct Quest Board reward.
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar for cool-colored recipes.
entries.icon_hint: a small heap of fine pale powder in blue-cyan-violet gradient, like frost ground fine

entries.name: Glass Shard
entries.description: Combines into glasses, lenses and see-through cosmetics.
entries.how_to_get: A materials-pool roll in Large Pocket Bags, Common Crates and (in bulk) Rare Crates, plus a rare direct trickle from hub parkour runs and opening the Daily Chest.
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar for transparent or lens-based recipes.
entries.icon_hint: a single jagged triangular shard of clear glass with a faint light-blue tint and a sharp glinting edge

entries.name: Glow Powder
entries.description: Combines into glowing and neon cosmetics.
entries.how_to_get: A materials-pool roll in Large Pocket Bags, Common Crates and Rare Crates, plus a rare direct trickle from hub parkour runs, opening the Daily Chest, and Diamond Trophy act clears.
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar for glowing or neon-effect recipes.
entries.icon_hint: a small pile of luminous yellow-green powder that appears to emit its own soft light

entries.name: Forged Steel
entries.how_to_get: A materials-pool roll in Large Pocket Bags, Common Crates and Rare Crates, plus a rare direct trickle from hub parkour runs, opening the Daily Chest, Diamond Trophy act clears and the Goblin King boss fight.
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar for metal-themed recipes, and for the Common Key crafting recipe (4 Forged Steel + 30 Base Material, instant - no altar slot time).
entries.icon_hint: a single polished silver-grey metal ingot with faint hammer-mark texture

entries.name: Rainbow Powder
entries.description: For cosmetics that cannot pick one color.
entries.how_to_get: One of the possible outcomes of a Common Crate's guaranteed bonus "chase" roll, and a materials-pool roll in Rare Crates. Not a direct Quest Board or pocket-bag reward.
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar for multi-colored, high-tier recipes.
entries.icon_hint: a small swirl of shimmering powder cycling through every color at once, like ground opal or crushed amethyst catching light

entries.name: Luck Essence
entries.description: Sharpens the loot inside chests and bags.
entries.how_to_get: One of the possible outcomes of a Common Crate's guaranteed bonus "chase" roll, and a materials-pool roll in Rare Crates. Not actually a Quest Board reward despite the old description - quests only ever pay pocket bags, crates and keys.
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar for high-tier recipes.
entries.icon_hint: a small glowing four-leaf clover charm on a short cord, faintly sparkling

entries.name: Goblin Skin
entries.description: Combines into Diamond Trophy exclusive cosmetics.
entries.how_to_get: A small chance (roughly 3% per kill, capped at 20 finds/day) from any Diamond Trophy enemy kill during a run - any of the 7 mob types, not just Goblins - a better chance (roughly 40%, capped at 6/day) from clearing an act, and the best odds of all from defeating the Goblin King (capped at 2/day, paid out to every surviving player in the room, not just whoever landed the final hit).
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar, only for Diamond Trophy exclusive recipes (like the Goblin Crown hat and the Cannon Pack).
entries.icon_hint: a folded strip of mottled greenish leathery hide with a faint sheen
entries.notes: Stacks without limit. Only ever drops inside Diamond Trophy, and can only be spent on Diamond Trophy exclusive cosmetics - it can never be required by a cosmetic wearable network-wide.

entries.name: Cannon Ash
entries.description: Combines into fiery blades and weapon skins.
entries.how_to_get: The Goblin King's cannonade in Diamond Trophy.
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar, only for Diamond Trophy exclusive recipes (like the Cannon Pack body cosmetic).
entries.icon_hint: a small smoking heap of dark grey ash with a few glowing orange embers still visible inside it
entries.notes: Stacks without limit. Only drops from the Goblin King boss fight in Diamond Trophy.

entries.name: Orange Plastic
entries.description: Combines into things nobody asked for.
entries.how_to_get: Somewhere in Diamond Trophy. Keep an eye out.
entries.how_to_use: Spent as an ingredient at the Crafting Altar for the Orange Bucket hat, a Diamond Trophy exclusive joke cosmetic that needs only three of it.
entries.icon_hint: a small chunky chipped block of bright orange plastic, oddly out of place among the other materials
entries.notes: Stacks without limit. A deliberately rare easter-egg drop - mostly from smashing pots in Diamond Trophy (a very small chance, capped to at most one such find per day), and occasionally from the Goblin King boss fight.
